design_concept.philosophy: Corporate precision meets high usability. The DHL Overtime Approval System is designed for quick decision-making and clear data visualization. It strictly uses DHL's brand colors (Yellow and Red) with a clean, high-contrast, professional structure.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D40511] text-white hover:bg-[#B9040F] font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FFCC00] text-slate-900 hover:bg-[#E5B800] font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-colors

components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
components.inputs: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-4 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFCC00] focus:border-[#FFCC00] outline-none text-slate-900 bg-white
components.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-900 text-white min-h-screen border-r border-slate-800

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows, mostly flat design
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg for main containers, rounded-md for buttons/inputs

images.description: Yellow DHL van, used as a subtle background or side image on the login screen.
DHL logo reference (abstract yellow/black) to be used as a logo placeholder in the sidebar or header.
Corporate office people meeting, can be used in the welcome banner of the dashboard.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all icons. Standardize stroke-width to 2.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on DHL Red (#D40511) and dark slate text on DHL Yellow (#FFCC00) for strict WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use light theme as default. Use #F8FAFC as the main app background and white for cards/surfaces.
Use DHL Yellow (#FFCC00) for active states, highlights, or secondary buttons (with dark text).
Use DHL Red (#D40511) for primary actions, warnings, and the reject button.
Implement a persistent sidebar for navigation (Manager vs. Gerencia views).
The dashboard should use a dense bento grid (Control Room grid) for metric cards.
Tables should be clean, using Shadcn Table components with clear status badges.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and major links.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
